reason: A Windows desktop-control plugin for agents, providing UI observation, screenshots, semantic and coordinate-based mouse actions, keyboard input, waiting, and optional vision-API analysis; human review is appropriate because it can directly operate desktop applications and transmit screenshots externally.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供 Windows 桌面观察、截图、鼠标键盘操作、UI 自动化和可选视觉 API 分析能力。
summaries.en: Provides agents with Windows desktop observation, screenshots, mouse and keyboard control, UI automation, and optional vision API analysis.

capabilities: Observes Windows UI Automation trees and window metadata
Captures window screenshots and sends images to a configured vision API
Clicks UI elements and performs coordinate-based mouse movement, scrolling, and dragging
Enters text and sends keyboard input to Windows applications
Waits for UI elements and writes values through UI automation patterns
